name: 00-shipped-scope-blind
desc: Control: `recall()` exactly as shipped — no scope argument, no origin filter. Not one of the ten; measured to show what the default does today.

name: 01-facts-only
desc: The shipped `facts` table used correctly: FTS5, `valid_to IS NULL`, scope passed as a hard partition. The honest baseline.

name: 02-episodic
desc: Adds `episodes` + FTS5 over the existing event stream. The tier Jod entirely lacks.

name: 03-trust-admission
desc: Excludes `origin='untrusted'` from the answer set at read time, and keeps it out of the hop. Free; closes the poisoning hole.

name: 04-entities-mentions
desc: Adds `entities` / `entity_aliases` / `mentions`, populated by deterministic alias matching. Index only — no traversal yet.

name: 05-hop-merged
desc: One-hop expansion over `mentions`, merged into the same k slots. Deliberately the merge policy FINDINGS.md measured as a net loss.

name: 06-hop-reserved
desc: Same hop, into RESERVED extra slots. Round one is never displaced.

name: 07-typed-edges
desc: The 'real graph': a separate `edges` table filled by triple extraction, traversed instead of `mentions`. Needs a second delegated extraction pass.

name: 08-edges-as-facts
desc: Drops the `edges` table. `facts.subject_entity` / `object_entity` + a `graph_edges` VIEW, so an edge inherits bi-temporal validity, origin and scope. Hop goes back over `mentions`.

name: 09-prospective
desc: Adds `intentions` — time and event cues, fired by a deterministic tick — plus the skills tier declared as procedural memory.

name: 10-final-trimmed
desc: Everything that paid, nothing that did not: weighted ranking (origin / salience / evidence / contested), a RELATIVE score floor, reserved hop, identity blocks. No typed edges, no merged hop, no decay.

name: XX-hop-gated
desc: Ablation on the winner: the reserved hop fires only when round one returned fewer than 3 results. One untuned trial.

name: XX-substring-alias
desc: Ablation on the winner: entity aliases matched by naive substring instead of token boundary.

name: XX-head-only-tombstone
desc: Ablation on the winner: retraction closes only the head version instead of purging every one.
